title: Hussain ghaiz mein hai
body:
Hussain ghaiz mein hai
Hussain... Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj maidaa'n mein husain ibn e ali ghaiz mein hai
fatema ghaiz mein hai, haqq ke wali ghaiz mein hai
<<DIVIDER>>
saath shabbir ke jitne hai sabhi ghaiz mein hai
aisa lagta hai sawa laakh nabi ghaiz mein hai
<<DIVIDER>>
apni talwaar se baazi ye palat dega hussain
aaj maidaa'n ko jahannam mein ulat dega hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
al hafeez o al-amaa'n..(4)
Hussain ghaiz mein hai..(10)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj maidaa'n mein husain ibn e ali ghaiz mein hai
fatema ghaiz mein hai, haqq ke wali ghaiz mein hai
<<DIVIDER>>
saath shabbir ke jitne hai sabhi ghaiz mein hai
aisa lagta hai sawa laakh nabi ghaiz mein hai
<<DIVIDER>>
apni talwaar se baazi ye palat dega hussain
aaj maidaa'n ko jahannam mein ulat dega hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain ghaiz mein hai..(4)
1. Faisla kun mere maula ki ladayi hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon mein tarr abhi darya ki tarayi hogi
maut ke sarpe ghata maut ki chayi hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
aise maidaan mein har saff ki safayi hogi
denge koofe mein khabar bhaag ke jaane wale
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaago bhaago yaha'n shabbir hai aane wale
Hussain ghaiz mein hai..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Abhi khul jayega shabbir akele kya hai
fatemi sher ke aage ye darinde kya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne qamat e tauheed ke bole kya hai
shaam ke soorma apne ko samajhte kya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hoga is shaan se hamla asad e talib ka
kalma padh padhke marenge ye abu talib ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain ghaiz mein hai..(4)
3. Hogayi jung pe aamada khuda ki qudrat
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaiz ko deke jagah hatt gayi peeche rehmat
pyaar se baat ki lekin nahi samjhi ummat
<<DIVIDER>>
chhe mahine se bohot shor tha bay'at bay'at
tegh kuch der mein jab ibn e ali kholega
<<DIVIDER>>
koi bay'at to kuja be bhi nhi bolega
Hussain ghaiz mein hai..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Aasteeno ko ulat-te hai hussain ibn e ali
murtajiz se yaha shamsheer ali ki boli
<<DIVIDER>>
saath dena hai tujhe mera aye rehwar e nabi
aakhri jung hai ye qabl e zahoor e Mehdi(a.t.f.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj har munkir e maula ko jakadna hoga
nau(9) imamo ki taraf se mujhe ladna hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain ghaiz mein hai..(4)
5. Murtajiz bola mujhe bhi nahi aata hai qaraar
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ki nusrat ke liye mai hu azal se tayyar
dekh chehre pe numaya hai ghazab ke aasaar
<<DIVIDER>>
yu udata hu mai khaak apne sumo se har baar
shamiyo ko hai batani mujhe hadd bay'at ki
<<DIVIDER>>
pao se khod raha hu mai lahad bay'at ki
Hussain ghaiz mein hai..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Shamiyo..shamiyo ibn e ali behre qitaal aaya hai
aaj allah ki rehmat ko jalaal aaya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Allah allah re shabbir ki aamad ka jalaal
teghe kham hoti hai dhaale hui jaati hai nidhaal
<<DIVIDER>>
asr se pehle hua jaata hai lashkar ka zawaal
Shimr, khooli umar e saad sabhi hai behaal
<<DIVIDER>>
khauf se aata nahi hai bine kahil rann mein
chupte phirte hai alamdaar ke qatil rann mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya zahra....
6. Kehke ya zahra jo maula ne nikali talwaar
<<DIVIDER>>
darr gaye dekhke kuch log nirali talwaar
kuch ne choro ki tarha peeche chupali talwaar
<<DIVIDER>>
boli ye shaam ke lashkar se jalaali talwaar
waar se apne sabhi fitne karungi tukde
<<DIVIDER>>
gin na payegi qaza itne karungi tukde
Hussain ghaiz mein hai..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Afra tafree thi wo bhagdad thi wo halchal tauba
khoon se aisi bani dasht mein daldal tauba
<<DIVIDER>>
apne halaat pe khud karta tha maqtal tauba
keh raha tha malakul maut musalsal tauba
<<DIVIDER>>
khud ko girte hue har baar sambhala usne
sar bachate hue rooho ko nikala usne
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain ghaiz mein hai..(4)
8. Dekh kar tegh e dosar neher se sarke zalim
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaagte phirte hai sab lashkar e sharr ke zalim
jaye to jaye kaha'n shaah se darr ke zalim
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaat ke baaqi rahe aur na ghar ke zalim
ghar mein bhi ghusne na ab denge inhe ghar wale
<<DIVIDER>>
kaaf-te-ye se bhi badd tar hue lashkar wale
Hussain ghaiz mein hai..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Dum nikalta tha kisi ka koi be dum dekha
sakht garmi mein ajab sardi ka aalam dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon jamte hue sharyano mein payham dekha
fauj mein jisko uthaye hue parcham dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
qatle abbas e alamdaar ka qazi bankar
sheh ne wo haath qalam kardiya ghaazi bankar
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain ghaiz mein hai..(4)
10. Maut bhi raqs mein thi kaisa ajab tha manzar
<<DIVIDER>>
ek anbaar tarai pe tha lasho'n ka udhar
ye sama dekhne thehri hui sab ki thi nazar
<<DIVIDER>>
khauf se neher mein jo doob gaye the jakar
mojein kehti thi unhein maar ke thokar niklo
<<DIVIDER>>
dushman e hazrat e shabbir ho baher niklo
Hussain ghaiz mein hai..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Dekh kar sheh ka ghazab bole farishte paiham
hone wali hai khudai abhi darham barham
<<DIVIDER>>
bole jibreel na ghabrao farishto iss dam
khaliq e arz o sama hai yehi khaliq ki qasam
<<DIVIDER>>
kya hua aaj khudai jo mita denge hussain
phir se duniya nayi kun kehke bana denge hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain ghaiz mein hai..(4)
12. Neher bhi kehti thi yeh baat yehi sehra bhi
<<DIVIDER>>
khauf ke maare hue kehte rahe aada bhi
zinda to zinda sadaa deta tha ye murda bhi
<<DIVIDER>>
tegh bhi haider e qarraar ki hai beta bhi
iss se bachne ki tamanna hai to lillah padh lo
<<DIVIDER>>
jitne zinda ho aliyun waliyullah padh lo
Hussain ghaiz mein hai..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
13. Murtaza ki ye sadaa aati thi shabash hussain
maa(j. Zahra(s.a.) takallum bhi kahe jaati thi shabash hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
jad ka paighaam hawa laati thi shabash hussain
zaat e wajib bhi yeh farmati thi shabash hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
daad dete tere ajdaad bhi aisa ladta
mai badan rakhta tu bilkul tere jaisa ladta
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain ghaiz mein hai..(4)
author: Mir Hassan Mir
